'''Streamline diffusion''', given an [[advection equation|advection]]-[[diffusion equation]], refers to all [[diffusion]] going on along the advection direction.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Roos|first1=Hans-Görg|last2=Zarin|first2=Helena|date=2003-01-01|title=The streamline-diffusion method for a convection–diffusion problem with a point source|journal=Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics|language=en|volume=150|issue=1|pages=109–128|doi=10.1016/S0377-0427(02)00568-X|bibcode=2003JCoAM.150..109R|issn=0377-0427|doi-access=free}}</ref>
